summary: Full backend + frontend testing for iter_10: agent online/offline toggle, status log reports (own + admin), 120s heartbeat auto-offline, assignment preference for online agents (fallback when none), admin stats online flag, and agent-side quick-reply library CRUD (shared library, creator-restricted delete). Backend: 17/17 pytest cases PASS on preview URL (/app/backend/tests/test_cs_status_qrlib.py, 6.4s). Verified: POST /cs/agent/status toggles idempotently (duplicate online -> no extra log segment), /cs/agent/me + /cs/agent/sessions return online flag and act as heartbeat, status-log returns rows with date/first_online/last_offline/online_minutes/segments/online_now, status-log shape (CN timezone), auto-offline triggers after backdating last_seen_at 5min in Mongo (verified both via /me response flipping to false AND via raw cs_agent_status_log insert with auto:true), assignment fallback when no agent online, assignment prefers online agent (temp agent created via admin API received all 3 /cs/start sessions over offline agent01, then cleaned up), admin status-log 401/403 without JWT and shape with 2 top-level keys days+online_now, admin stats contains online boolean per agent, agent QR create text+image required (400 if both empty), agent can delete own QR (200) but gets 403 on admin-created QR, list GET returns {replies,me}. Frontend: /cs agent01 login OK, cs-wb-toggle-online flips cs-wb-status-text 在线接待中<->已下线 and persists after full reload, cs-wb-log-btn opens cs-status-log-modal with cs-status-log-table showing today's segments (09:56-09:56, 09:57-09:59, 10:00-10:02, 10:02-至今 incl. the auto-offline from the pytest), cs-qrlib-add opens cs-qrlib-form, filling cs-qrlib-form-group=TEST_UI_grp + text + clicking cs-qrlib-form-save creates item and new group tab cs-qrlib-group-TEST_UI_grp appears with cs-qrlib-del-<id> delete icon (only on own items), native confirm() dialog accepted and item deleted, group tab disappears. /admin login OK, second '在线客服' tab shows 坐席管理 table with cs-agent-online-<id> badge '在线' (green), cs-status-log-admin section with rows cs-status-row-* and day filters cs-status-days-7/14/30 all working (switched to 14), QR library panel shows items with 坐席「客服小海」添加 label. Regression: visitor /chat (390px) still renders agent header, welcome + 3 FAQ buttons (visitor-chat-faq-*), input visitor-chat-input + visitor-chat-send intact. Main site / renders dark (body bg rgb(6,11,24)). Agent01 left ONLINE at end of testing per instructions.
action_items: Pre-existing (from iter_9): React 'Encountered two children with the same key cc61c833-...' warning still fires on every poll tick in /cs CSWorkbench — likely a session/message dedupe gap in the polling merge. Not visually broken but noisy in console. Suggested fix: dedupe by id with `Array.from(new Map(items.map(x=>[x.id,x])).values())` before setState in the sessions/messages polling branches.
QR library delete uses native window.confirm() — fine, but consider a shadcn AlertDialog for consistency with the rest of the admin UI.
critical_code_review_comments: agent_auto_offline_if_stale correctly logs offline using last_seen_at (not now) so retroactive segments appear in the right day; auto flag propagates to segments via build_status_report. Confirmed via raw-collection check (auto:true offline doc inserted).

cs_agent_set_status is idempotent: it only writes a status_log entry when `bool(agent.get('online')) != data.online`, preventing duplicate online->online log pollution (verified by segment-count-stability test).
assign_cs_agent prefers online agents and falls back to any enabled agent when none are online (both branches covered by tests).
cs_agent_qr_delete filters on {id, created_by: agent.id} — admin-created items can never be deleted by agents (returns 403). Admin can delete anything via /admin/cs/quick-replies/{id}.
/admin/cs/stats now includes `online: bool` per agent (agent_is_online check already honors 120s staleness).

Minor obs: build_status_report returns rows only for (date, agent) pairs with activity, not padded empty days — frontend StatusLogTable needs to handle sparse rows (admin UI already does, confirmed visually).
No ObjectId leakage anywhere; all find() calls project `_id: 0`.
Pydantic validation on QRLibraryInput enforces text OR image → 400 Chinese error message, consistent with existing admin endpoint.
